name: Filterable Post Gallery
author: Pluximo

sections.description:
Turn Your WordPress Posts into a Beautiful Gallery

Organize your content in a visually appealing way that makes it easy for visitors to find what they’re looking for. This plugin creates an interactive gallery with filtering capabilities to improve content organization.

Perfect for:
* Bloggers – Showcase your best articles in an organized, visual way
* Businesses – Display services, case studies, or team members professionally
* Content Creators – Help visitors find exactly what they’re looking for quickly

Think of it like organizing your content into easily browsable categories – but much more engaging than boring lists!

What makes this plugin special:

✅ Easy to use – Works with WordPress block editor, see changes right away
✅ Smart filtering – Visitors click buttons to see posts from specific categories
✅ Works on all devices – Looks great on phones, tablets, and computers
✅ Very fast – Built to load quickly and not slow down your website
✅ Display posts and products – Support for WordPress posts and product post types
✅ Good for Google – Search engines can easily read your content

What You Get

✅ Professional gallery layout – Posts displayed in an attractive, organized grid
✅ One-click filtering – Visitors easily find content by clicking category buttons
✅ Mobile-friendly design – Looks perfect on all devices automatically
✅ Beginner-friendly setup – No coding required, works in minutes
✅ Lightning fast – Optimized code that won’t slow down your site
✅ Color customization – Customize button and card colors to match your brand
✅ Flexible display options – Show full content or image-only layouts

Perfect For These Websites

  • Portfolio websites – Show your work projects organized by type
  • Photo blogs – Display pictures organized by event or style
  • Business websites – Show your services or team members
  • Regular blogs – Make your blog posts easier to find and read
  • Online stores – Show products that visitors can sort by category
  • News websites – Organize articles by topic or date
  • School websites – Show courses or resources by subject
  • Real estate sites – Display properties by type or location

How to Use It

  1. Go to edit any page on your website
  2. Click the + button to add a new block
  3. Search for “Filterable Post Gallery” and add it
  4. Choose posts or pages to display
  5. Categories will automatically appear as filter buttons
  6. Customize colors and settings as needed
  7. Save your page – you are done!

Your gallery will load fast and work well with Google search.

Requirements

Your website needs:
* WordPress 6.8 or newer
* PHP 8.1 or newer
* MySQL 5.6 or newer database

Browsers that work:
* Chrome 90 and newer
* Firefox 88 and newer
* Safari 14 and newer
* Edge 90 and newer
* Mobile browsers (iPhone, Android)

What you need to know:
* How to add blocks in WordPress editor
* Basic understanding of posts and categories
* No coding skills needed!

Performance & Compatibility

Built for:
* Fast loading websites
* Mobile-first design
* Good Google search results
* Easy to use for everyone
* Works in multiple languages

Works with:
* All modern WordPress themes
* Popular page builders
* WooCommerce online stores
* Custom post type plugins
* Caching plugins (for faster websites)
* Security plugins

Privacy

This plugin does not collect any personal information from your visitors. Everything stays on your website. We respect your privacy and your visitors’ privacy.

Need Help?

If you need help, visit the WordPress support forum for this plugin. We are here to help you succeed with your website!

Credits

sections.installation:
Easy Way

  1. Go to your WordPress admin area
  2. Click Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Filterable Post Gallery”
  4. Click Install and then Activate
  5. You are ready to use it!

Manual Way

  1. Download the plugin file
  2. Upload it to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Turn it on in your WordPress admin
  4. Start using it right away!
sections.faq:
Can I use this with different types of posts?

Yes! The plugin supports:
* Regular WordPress posts
* Product post type (commonly used by WooCommerce)

Can I filter by different categories?

Yes! The plugin supports filtering by any WordPress taxonomy:
* Post categories
* Product categories (WooCommerce)
* Tags
* Any custom taxonomy registered on your site

Does it work on mobile phones?

Yes! It works perfectly on:
* All mobile phones
* Tablets
* Desktop computers
* All modern web browsers

Will it make my website slow?

No! This plugin is built to be fast:
* Uses simple, clean code
* Does not load heavy external files
* Designed to help your website load quickly
* Good for Google speed tests

How much can I change how it looks?

The plugin includes comprehensive customization options:
* Button colors – Background, text, hover, and active states
* Card colors – Background, title, and excerpt colors
* Display options – Show content with images or image-only layout
* Posts per page – Display 2-16 posts in your gallery
* Placeholder images – Automatic placeholders for posts without featured images

Does it work with my WordPress theme?

Yes! It works with:
* All modern WordPress themes
* New block-based themes
* Older classic themes
* Popular theme brands and frameworks

Is it good for Google search?

Yes! Here is why:
* Google can easily read your content
* Fast loading times
* Works well on mobile devices
* Clean, organized code
* Good website structure

Can I have more than one gallery on a page?

Yes! You can add as many galleries as you want to any page. Each gallery works by itself with its own settings.

What happens if I turn off the plugin?

Your posts stay safe! The galleries will show as regular post lists without the filter buttons. You will not lose any content.

Do you help if I have problems?

Yes! We provide:
* Help through WordPress.org support forums
* Documentation and guides
* Regular updates to fix problems
* Updates to work with new WordPress versions
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Performance Improvements:
    • Implemented query caching with WordPress transients
    • Automatic cache invalidation when posts are saved
  • Code Quality:
    • Refactored to modern JavaScript and CSS
    • Added render helper for better code organization
    • Added comprehensive test coverage
  • UX & Editor Improvements:
    • Enhanced block editor experience

1.0.0

  • First version – Welcome to Filterable Post Gallery!
  • Core Features:
    • Works with WordPress block editor
    • Grid layout that adjusts to different screen sizes
    • Smooth filtering when clicking buttons
    • Support for posts and product post types
    • Filtering by any WordPress taxonomy
    • Comprehensive color customization
    • Good for search engines
  • Display Options:
    • Full content view with title and excerpt
    • Image-only layout for visual galleries
    • Automatic placeholder images for posts without featured images
    • Configurable posts per page (2-16)
  • Fast performance:
    • Uses optimized JavaScript code
    • Dynamic CSS styling system
    • Built for fast websites
    • Works great on mobile devices
  • Technical details:
    • Works with WordPress 6.8 and newer
    • Requires PHP 8.1 or newer
    • Clean, accessible code
    • Can have multiple galleries on one page
